newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: PSL, Kersten Hunik set up Manchester company.
newsitem.headline: PSL, Kersten Hunik set up Manchester company.

text.p: Dutch forwarder Kersten Hunik Hoofddorp BV and the UK forwarding group, PSL Group Ltd, have formed a jointly-owned company in Manchester, a PSL statement said.

PSL and Kersten Hunik group have been working together over the last 18 months and under the latest move PSL has taken a 51 percent share in Kersten Hunik International Ltd - the Dutch group's Manchester subsidiary.
The latter is now called Kersten-PSL Ltd.
John King, PSL managing director, said: "This will build on the strong links we have already established with Kersten Hunik in a number of European locations over the past 18 months."
He added PSL can now offer customers based in the north of the UK a wider range of value added freight services including new links to Ireland, the Netherlands, Germany and Italy.

PSL's strategic alliance with Kersten Hunik began in the Dutch market but was extended to Ireland in the past year. This co-operation was recently widened to take in Kersten Hunik's Frankfurt office, the statement said.
The Kersten-PSL centre is based in Irlam, Manchester and is a combined office/warehouse facility, providing some 20,000 sq ft. --Reuters Air Cargo Newsroom Tel+44 171 542-7706 Fax+5017
